name: Parker Jones
story: Parker Jones worked in Prime/Eagle sales and implementation during the later-1980s expansion of Esri GIS in New Zealand. He had a substantial commercial role; the record does not support assigning the introduction of GIS in New Zealand to one person.
A Royal Society Wellington Branch biography describes Parker Jones’s role in selecting, importing, selling and supporting software, including Esri GIS.
